title: polystichum acrostichoides var. schweinitzii
intro: Polystichum acrostichoides var. schweinitzii, commonly known as the Mountain Lady Fern, is a variety of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. The health benefits of Mountain Lady Fern include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and act as a natural diuretic. Its therapeutic actions include its antispasmodic and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve coughs and other respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Lady Fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
